verdict.rationale: Bland documents its own batch-calls capability, which launches high-volume call campaigns from an uploaded CSV of recipients. That is a genuine bulk operation, but the evidence shows bulk action only for outbound call dispatch, from a single thin doc mention. missing for 10: bulk operations on other item types (agents, pathways, numbers, call logs), documented batch API/CLI/MCP endpoints, details on batch status/management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Batch calls let you initiate high-volume call campaigns by uploading a list of recipients via CSV.
